digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. The day’s planned dashboard priorities were completed, while live Amazon Connect testing surfaced fresh call-routing issues that need continued attention. Friday’s schedule is anchored by EOW preparation, a 3:00 PM conflict, and the final Amazon stress-test block.

items.detail: Coverage for the Knowledge Management/SVC overlap and the Amazon UAT/Tudo Bem overlap was completed.

items.label: Completed launch-day monitoring for the Legal Request Tool pilot
items.detail: The first-day monitoring and ownership follow-through for the pilot was completed.

items.label: Resolve the Amazon Connect call-routing test failures
items.detail: During the afternoon UAT session, testers reported that calls were not reaching available agents and asked for live help on SCN-02. Capture the failed scenarios and confirm the next technical owner before Friday’s stress test.

items.label: Track Rippling’s response on the PM working-schedule case

items.detail: Use the SVC standup to confirm UAT recovery, then carry the latest status into the Salesforce program standup.

items.label: 4:00-5:00 PM - Amazon Connect concurrent stress test
items.detail: Use the final UAT block to retest call routing, document unresolved failures, and close evidence gaps before the weekend.
